claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The proposal allocates 256,000 ADA to WP 1, 832,000 ADA to WP 2, and 105,000 ADA to WP 3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states that WP3 independent technical reviews will use formal conflict-of-interest provisions, recorded and published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to Hydra voting results and audit documentation.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, named oversight entities, specified multisignature authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support across technical coordination, protocol governance, and technical review, with budget totals, governance-process references, smart-contract custody details, and several accountability commitments.
